checks.criterion: Sinusoid x values approach the analytic limit within a derived finite-window tolerance; y gives zero.
checks.evidence: Independently derived nu² = 2*A²*sin²(pi*L/lambda)*(1+C), with abs(C) <= 1/(M*abs(sin(2*pi*spacing/lambda))). The executable references and assertions at pipeline/tests/test_terrain_structure.py:265-341 implement this bound, an exact finite-window sum, supported y zeros, and increasing window sizes.
